t_advice_summary_textbox.text: blue and yellow gnomes lead to yellow basket. red and orange gnomes lead to red basket. keep choosing 1 colour basket. use x 1 multiplier to check for mushroom quantity between basket. this will lead to more mushrooms

vb_textbox.text: the greyer coloured gnomes such as red, orange and purple lead to a red basket. The lighter coloured gnomes such as blue, yellow and green bring you to the yellow basket. During the 5 x always aim to get to the same coloured basket. during the 1 x rounds use this as an oportunity to check each basket to see which offers the most mushrooms.
